notes: The two Γαλιλαῖος tokens are aligned separately to their own English words (rule 26).
ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν split as *he answered* / *and said*, the juncture going to the finite verb it introduces under rule 88.
ταῦτα → *these things* is anarthrous, so rule 17's generic-noun clause holds the head on the demonstrative.
